    sql_query = f"""
    SELECT ROUND("Invoice Number" * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nch___company_info), {precision}) AS ratio_sql
    FROM nch___sales_invoices
    """
    df_sql_precision = pd.read_sql(sql_query, conn)
    
    df_py_precision = df_py.copy()
    df_py_precision['ratio_py'] = np.round(df_py_precision['ratio_py'], precision)
    
    comparison_precision = df_sql_precision['ratio_sql'] == df_py_precision['ratio_py']
    equal_rows_precision = comparison_precision.sum()
    
    print(f"Precision {precision}: Equal rows = {equal_rows_precision}, Unequal rows = {len(df_sql_precision) - equal_rows_precision}")
    
    if equal_rows_precision == len(df_sql_precision):
        print(f"SUCCESS! All rows match at precision {precision}")
        break

# Final verification with the best precision
if equal_rows_precision == len(df_sql_precision):
    print("\n=== Final verification ===")
    print(f"All {len(df_sql_precision)} rows have equal ratios!")
    
    # Create final comparison dataframe
    final_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'Invoice_Number': df_py['Invoice Number'],
        'SQL_Ratio': df_sql_precision['ratio_sql'],
        'Python_Ratio': df_py_precision['ratio_py']
    })
    
    # Check if any differences remain
    final_diffs = final_df['Python_Ratio'] - final_df['SQL_Ratio']
    max_diff = final_diffs.max()
    min_diff = final_diffs.min()
    print(f"Maximum difference: {max_diff}")
    print(f"Minimum difference: {min_diff}")
    
    if np.all(final_diffs == 0):
        print("PERFECT MATCH! All rows have identical ratios.")
    else:
        print(f"Still have {len(np.where(final_diffs != 0)[0])} rows with differences")
        
else:
    print("\n=== Still not matching, trying alternative approach ===")
    
    # Try casting both to same type
    sql_query_final = """
    SELECT CAST("Invoice Number" AS REAL) / CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nch___company_info) AS REAL) AS ratio_sql
    FROM nch___sales_invoices
    """
    df_sql_final = pd.read_sql(sql_query_final, conn)
    
    # Python already uses float division
    comparison_final = df_sql_final['ratio_sql'] == df_py['ratio_py']
    equal_final = comparison_final.sum()
    print(f"With double CAST: Equal rows = {equal_final}")
    
    # If still not matching, use numpy.isclose for floating point comparison
    if equal_final < len(df_sql_final):
        print("\n=== Using numpy.isclose for floating point tolerance ===")
        
        tolerance = 1e-15
        close_comparison = np.isclose(df_sql_final['ratio_sql'], df_py['ratio_py'], rtol=tolerance, atol=tolerance)
        close_equal = close_comparison.sum()
        print(f"Rows within tolerance {tolerance}: {close_equal}")
        
        if close_equal == len(df_sql_final):
            print("All rows are numerically equivalent within tolerance!")
        else:
            print(f"Still {len(df_sql_final) - close_equal} rows differ beyond tolerance")
            
            # Try to identify problematic rows
            not_close_indices = np.where(~close_comparison)[0]
            print(f"\n=== Problematic rows (first 3) ===")
            for i in not_close_indices[:3]:
                invoice_num = df_py.iloc[i]['Invoice Number']
                sql_ratio = df_sql_final.iloc[i]['ratio_sql']
                py_ratio = df_py.iloc[i]['ratio_py']
                diff = py_ratio - sql_ratio
                print(f"Row {i}: Invoice={invoice_num}, SQL={sql_ratio}, Python={py_ratio}, diff={diff}")
                print(f"  Relative diff: {diff/sql_ratio if sql_ratio != 0 else 'inf'}")
